fields.acceptance: A testscript runs rhiza daemon --once against a fake Rex: the run's driver starts as a process with no rex window new for it, its output lands in the run's log file, and rhiza run ls shows the run live after the daemon has exited
fields.statement: The daemon starts and resumes each run as a detached rhiza run start or rhiza run resume process in the repo, outside Rex, with its output in the run's log file under .git/rhiza, so no Rex tab holds a run's driver and a run still outlives the daemon; this replaces the run tab of daemon-run-tabs

fields.acceptance: A testscript: rhiza run start <cs> queues the run and prints that it waits for the daemon; rhiza daemon --once then starts it headless, or leaves it queued while maxRuns runs are live; rhiza run start --foreground drives the run in the calling process; a unit test on the roadmap app's fake runner shows its start key queueing the run
fields.statement: rhiza run start and the roadmap app's start keys queue the run for the daemon, which starts it headless within maxRuns, instead of driving it in the caller's tab; with no daemon running they say the run waits for one; rhiza run start --foreground drives the run in place for debugging

fields.acceptance: A testscript with a fake Rex drives a headless run: each agent session calls rex window new -s rhiza-<repo> with a title naming the run and the step, no rex split is anchored on a driver block, and closing a finished session closes only its own tab
fields.statement: Each agent session of a headless run (agent steps, checks, fixers and question sessions) opens its own Rex tab in the repo's session, titled for the run and step, instead of splitting a run window anchored on the driver's pane; the run-window tiling leaves no longer apply to headless runs

fields.acceptance: A testscript: rhiza run log <run> prints the run's log file a page at a time with the paging flags ls takes, and exits 2 for a run with no log; a unit test on the live app's fake runner shows the key opening a layer running rhiza run log for the selected run
fields.statement: rhiza run log <run> pages a headless run's driver log, and a key in the live app opens the selected run's log in a Rex layer
